name: Mariano Mazza
bornNote: Named in his son Rosario's death act of 1924 as «fu Mariano già contadino», and in his grandson Salvatore's birth act of 1873 as «Rosario Mazza di Mariano». A contadino of Piedimonte Etneo, dead before 1924.
spouseNote: «fu Catalano Maria già casalinga» — named in Rosario's death act, 1924. Dead before 1924.
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Morti 1924, atto for 15 November; Nati 1873, atto 3

name: Rosario Mazza
bornNote: Aged 28 in January 1873, 31 in October 1877, 32 in May 1880, 53 in 1898, 55 in 1902, 65 in 1910 and 79 at death — seven records, one man. A bracciante, later contadino, of Contrada Terremorte, via Grotta Nicodemo and Contrada S. Basilio.
spouseNote: Daughter of Gaetano. Still living in 1910, when she and Rosario consented in person to their son Ignazio's marriage.
source: Nati 1873 atto 3; Nati 1877 atto 168; Nati 1880 atto 66; proclamations 1898, 1902, 1910; Morti 1924

name: Salvatore Mazza
bornNote: Born at seven in the morning in Contrada Terremorte, Piedimonte Etneo. NOT 1879, as the family tree has it.
spouseNote: Daughter of Giovanni Nicotra and Venera. Married 25 April 1898 in the parish of Piedimonte Etneo.
source: Nati 1873 atto 3; parish marriage 25 Apr 1898; Morti 1929 atto 9

name: Sebastiano Mazza
bornNote: Piedimonte Etneo. Sailed on the Toscana out of Genoa, 4 October 1949.
spouseNote: Of Briatico. Buried beside him at Nudgee, plots V-1026 and V-1027.

name: Mia Josephine Mazza and Rocco Francesco Mazza
spouseNote: The two children this archive is for.
